label.rationale: Some safeguards are present, but at least one required scope, threshold, or follow-up condition is missing.

control.title: Password strength for workforce accounts
control.description: Mock control, not authoritative. Workforce passwords should resist guessing and reuse.
evaluation_criteria: The enforced minimum password length is at least 14 characters.
A mix of character types or an equivalent breached-password check is enforced.
The effective configuration agrees with the written policy.
expected_evidence: Identity-provider or operating-system password policy export

repetitions.justification: The minimum password length is set to 8 characters, which is less than the required 14 characters. Additionally, breached password blocking is not enabled, which is a requirement for password strength enforcement.

criteria_assessment.criterion: The enforced minimum password length is at least 14 characters.
criteria_assessment.note: The effective policy minimum length is 8 characters, which is below the required 14 characters.

criteria_assessment.criterion: A mix of character types or an equivalent breached-password check is enforced.
criteria_assessment.note: The policy mentions complexity required but does not specify a mix of character types or a breached password check. Breached password blocking is disabled.

criteria_assessment.criterion: The effective configuration agrees with the written policy.
criteria_assessment.note: The minimum length is set to 8 characters, which is less than the required 14 characters, and breached password blocking is not enabled.

repetitions.recommendation: Increase the minimum password length to at least 14 characters and enable breached password blocking. Ensure that the effective configuration aligns with the written policy.
repetitions.prefix_cache_detection: reported prompt tokens < 70% of independently counted prompt tokens
